title: Pumpkin
body:
"It's orange. It's a Pumpkin"

Description

The Pumpkin is an item that can be bought at Ghoulish Goods for 822 Candy during the Halloween 2023 event.

In the Halloween 2024 event, Pumpkins can spawn in patches that spawn on Finlay Island. These pumpkins can vary in size, with bigger pumpkins being rarer than their smaller variants.

Depending on their size, pumpkins can sell for candy, increasing as they get bigger. This is also the case with Composters, as larger pumpkins can fill them quicker than their smaller variants.
